name: @kyora-sh/council
description: Summon councils of other model families from inside your coding agent — fan out a decision to Codex, Claude, GLM, Grok, Kimi and Qwen, or ask/delegate to one, over MCP

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --minify && bun build ./src/hook.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --minify && for f in index hook; do printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - ./dist/$f.js > ./dist/$f.tmp && mv ./dist/$f.tmp ./dist/$f.js && chmod +x ./dist/$f.js; done
